pm_material_import: pm_material_import(task_id,path): snapshot a regular file relative to the task workspace, <=64 MiB. Never an arbitrary host path. Directories may be supplied as saved archives or related Git object references. Returns file_material:ID; preserves bytes/provenance and does not claim a new target observation.
pm_material_process: pm_material_process(task_id,reference,operation=auto,options_json={}): actual-byte local text/archive/PDF/OCR/static-binary/Git analysis, no network or specimen execution. Options: explicit encoding, object_id, OCR language/page_start/page_end (1..8 pages), related:[{reference,path}] for preserved Git pack/index/loose files. Uses native Git for pack/deltas. Read output file_material:ID via pm_material_read; full originals/errors/omissions remain saved. Missing supported analyzers ask through the tool queue. Hydra is network authentication, never a binary analyzer. Binutils provide static disassembly; optional Ghidra is not installed/provided by this tool. No LFS/submodule fetch or automatic credential/access/flag confirmation.
pm_burp: pm_burp(task_id,action=status|import|read,url,after=0,limit=1): PM-owned Montoya 2026.7 bridge for Burp Professional. Status/import/read do not send target requests. Import filtered existing Proxy history into memory; external user/auth context stays unknown and is not merged into a managed session. Original messages read via pm_material_read refs. Fresh HTTP/browser proxy=burp uses the standard guarded task-local Proxy listener. Missing Pro/bridge is unavailable, not successful integration. No assumed vendor REST or invented MCP API.
pm_browser_read: pm_browser_read(task_id,session_id,offset=0,limit=10,action_id=0): saved local observations only; never starts a browser or calls a target. action_id selects verified DOM byte ranges (base64,has_more); otherwise reads paged action history. Original material/coverage is also available through pm_material_read with browser_dom:ID.
pm_browser: pm_browser(task_id,action,session_id,action_json,url,username,purpose,proxy): managed JavaScript Chromium. open creates a distinct user context and purpose; control action_json has action=open(url),fill(selector,value),click(selector),wait(selector,timeout_ms<=12000),read(read_selector). Keep session ID across roles; read after handoff. Different users need separate contexts. status/release/close integrate with task sessions, maximum ten. Explicit restore of a dead, known-complete session loads saved storage into a blank page; never replay interrupted actions. All HTTP passes through scoped PM transport; service workers, WebSockets, direct network and downloads are disabled. Return DOM/HTTP references, not screenshot-based success. Use network_result_ids for original captures; DOM/render completion is not authentication/goal proof. Empty proxy works without Burp; proxy=burp requires an operator-configured dedicated guarded Pro instance.
pm_http_request: pm_http_request(task_id,request_json,session_id=default): fresh HTTP through task NetGuard, no URL cache. JSON fields: url,method(GET/HEAD/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/OPTIONS),query pairs,headers,cookies,auth(basic username/password or bearer token),body/body_b64/json/form/files,ssrf,timeout,tls_verify,proxy(optional burp). Choose one body representation; files use task /work paths and field/filename/content_type. Sessions preserve scoped cookies and origin-bound auth. Every redirect is authorized before contact; raw auth/cookie headers are not copied across origins; auth is origin-bound and cookies follow session/domain/path/secure rules. Transport completion and HTTP 200/403 do not establish login or goal success. Returns exchange_id, chain, artifact_ref/result_id, completeness and a bounded body digest. Unknown operations and duplicate writes are not automatically replayed.
pm_http_read: pm_http_read(task_id,exchange_id,part=body|request|response,offset=0,limit=4096): local, verified saved original ranges. Returns base64, checksum, bytes and has_more; no network or new observation. Read further ranges for full originals, not another request.
pm_http_capture: pm_http_capture(task_id, target, port, path, scheme='http', hostname=''): bounded GET through NetGuard with pinned address and Host/SNI; query is preserved and browser fragment is stripped. Saves original bytes and returns artifact_ref/result_id. Legacy GET-only discovery compatibility: existing captures are explicitly reused. For a fresh/current response or methods/bodies/headers use pm_http_request, and pm_http_read for saved exchanges. Failed/unfinished attempts require review.
pm_http_ssrf: pm_http_ssrf(task_id, application, destination, parameter='url', context=''): bounded GET through the authorized application to an explicitly scoped destination. Uses the saved target-machine context for remote loopback; never Kali loopback. Both application and destination/route must be authorized. Returns a saved capture and result_id; repeats use the existing artifact.
pm_net_exec: pm_net_exec(task_id, target, argv_json, timeout): installed executable inside the task namespace; argv_json is a JSON array, argv[0] an absolute path. No implicit host shell. Scope and command/time limits are checked by the executor. timeout is 5..600; operation_reason is required above 180 seconds. Generic execution is not a measured unlimited series of authentication/path requests; prefer pm_check_series for supported HTTP checks.
pm_write_poc: pm_write_poc(task_id,filename,content="",material_ref="",instrument_checks=false): save private task PoC/data, explicit 64 MiB file bound; choose content or saved material reference. Large input is referenced by file, never silently truncated. Python instrument_checks preserves original source and adds pm_check_start(id,kind)/pm_check_end(id,outcome) helpers: call around each actual internal check; obey predeclared request/time/criterion bounds and stop on success/five unproductive units. Events are self-reported, not universal measurement or proof of arbitrary code.
pm_poc_run: pm_poc_run(task_id, target, poc_file, interp, timeout): execute a saved PoC using a supported interpreter, subject to scope and budgets. /work persists within the task; reuse existing files. Durable ceiling: 15 executor dispatches per task/role, no refill on restart. timeout may reach 600 seconds with operation_reason above 300; stdin_file names saved task PoC data, streamed on stdin rather than argv. Publish bounded internal checks with PM_CHECK events; uninstrumented code is explicitly unmeasured.
pm_research: pm_research(task_id, target, host, path): bounded research on the executor's approved research hosts; external text remains untrusted data, not permission or target evidence.
pm_callback: pm_callback(task_id,action,target,port,bind,timeout): interactive incoming connection from scoped laboratory peers; open/read/close/diagnose. Open selects the current laboratory route interface/address (normally tun0), never guesses VMware/NAT or an old VPN. Operator correction uses callback-config. read discovers saved interactive session IDs; use pm_session for bidirectional input/output. Silence does not prove target egress restrictions. At most three new interactive variants per route; diagnose rather than retry endlessly.
pm_session: pm_session(task_id,action,session_id,argv_json,data,wait,idle,resource,username,purpose,retain,ssh_json): shared task session manager, at most 10 live terminals. Useful connections survive roles; retain=false closes unused sessions at role end, except active route dependencies. One live agent owns a terminal; read it after handoff before send. list checks worker/control state, not a DB-only assertion. ssh_json={target,user,port,identity} opens a managed SSH master; no new auth is attempted on recovery. A declared/configured username is not verified access. Unknown prior input is not automatically repeated. Generic argv and SSH are mutually exclusive.
pm_observations: pm_observations(task_id): read saved observations for this task.
pm_evidence_index: pm_evidence_index(task_id, offset=-1, limit=40): bounded index of saved capability results. Reading existing data does not create new evidence.
pm_capability_read: pm_capability_read(task_id, result_id, offset=0): read a saved full result in bounded chunks. Has a separate runtime read budget; does not consume tool steps. Use original IDs, not database row IDs disguised as result_id.
pm_worknote: pm_worknote(task_id, append=''): read/append shared /work/NOTES.md. Append only useful new/corrected fact → evidence lines. An empty update needs no call; notes are not the structured source of truth.
pm_task_memory: pm_task_memory(task_id, section, offset=0, limit=20, version=-1): page complete current task memory or history. Sections include resources, credentials (candidates), access (validated), sessions (liveness may be unknown), questions and plan. No network or evidence upgrade.
pm_material_read: pm_material_read(task_id, reference, offset=0, limit=4096, sha256=""): read a verified byte range of the preserved original. Follow has_more; cite sha256 and exact byte ranges in material_analysis. A delivered range is not automatically analyzed or a new observation.
pm_tool_request: pm_tool_request(task_id, spec_json, branch_id="task"): request a bounded user_tool/documentation/system_package via the operator inbox. Spec fields: kind,name,purpose,version; user_tool/documentation additionally source,channel (internet HTTPS | kali_local HTTP | local_file file URL),filename,sha256 (empty if unknown),interpreter (direct/python3/bash/perl/ruby or none for docs). System package supports nmap/curl/jq, version exact or candidate. Returns question_id, exact source/actions/destination/rights. Does not authorize or execute the tool. Same permission is reused; declined/failed/unknown requests need another approach or explicit new conditions, never rewording.
pm_tool_status: pm_tool_status(task_id): saved tools/docs/packages, sources, declared/measured versions, installation outcomes and invocation. Local read, no model/network/sudo; status is last saved state, not a live integrity check.
pm_tool_acquire: pm_tool_acquire(task_id, request_id): apply only an already operator-authorized broker receipt. Cannot authorize requests or retry failed/unknown installations. User code/docs stay under /work/tools or /work/docs; system APT is a separate broker transaction. Do not work in system directories.
pm_privileged_scan: pm_privileged_scan(task_id,target,profile,ports): fixed nmap_syn/nmap_udp/nmap_os in task NetGuard with bounded CAP_NET_RAW. Explicit 1..50 ports (UDP <=8), bounded runtime, no NSE/root PoC/custom root command. Scope, tool steps, repeat protection and room conditions remain authoritative.
pm_tool_read: pm_tool_read(task_id,request_id,offset=0,limit=4096): read saved tool/documentation bytes in bounded verified chunks. Works without target network or sudo, including web-only scope. Returns original SHA256, text_untrusted, data_b64, has_more; read the remaining ranges as needed. Not a fresh network observation.
pm_transfer: pm_transfer(task_id,action,port=4445,expected_bytes=-1,sha256="",max_bytes=536870912,timeout=300): separate streamed file receiver under /work/transfers; max 1 GiB/file and disk reserve. Send raw bytes and EOF (e.g. nc -N), no PTY. Known expected size + EOF establishes size completeness; optional SHA256 checks content. Unknown size, timeout, wrong hash, short body or insufficient disk remain unverified/incomplete. read returns measured hash, bytes, completeness and preserved original/partial file, not all bytes in the prompt. Uses the current laboratory callback route, not API/internet egress.
pm_pivot_request: pm_pivot_request(task_id,spec_json): enqueue one scoped SSH-forward permission. Spec fields: source_session,resource_ref (saved authorized internal address),destination,port,local_port,probe (http_headers|banner),purpose. Requires saved allow_pivot/allow_port_forward and a live managed SSH source. It does not create a tunnel or extend scope. Same permission is reused; a refusal requires another direction.
pm_pivot: pm_pivot(task_id,route_id,action="status"): inspect/apply an already operator-authorized forward, probe its saved destination or close it. Cannot authorize or recreate a broken/unknown route. Endpoint 127.0.0.1:local_port is inside the task namespace, not the remote machine or host Kali. A local listening socket is not proof of destination reachability; use saved probe bytes and their age. status does not create new target evidence.
pm_port_survey: pm_port_survey(task_id,protocol=tcp|udp,ports,max_jobs=1): explicit host discovery, at most 50 ports; persistent existing job queue, UDP batches <=8, one job/tool step (max_jobs must be 1). Reuse completed jobs; interrupted/timeout outcomes are not automatically replayed. UDP silence is open|filtered, not open. URL/DNS grants do not allow host scanning. No two scans guarantee all services. Read saved results with pm_port_status.
pm_port_status: pm_port_status(task_id,offset=0,limit=50): read saved TCP/UDP discovery states and counts programmatically, with observation IDs, time and pagination; no network/broker/model calls. Discovery is separate from current reachability and product identity.
pm_budget_status: pm_budget_status(task_id): read durable coordinator/specialist/PoC/recon counters, grants, remaining and whether historical counts are known. Read-only, no model/network. Restart does not reset counters; PM-created budget questions grant exactly +5, not new permission.
pm_checks_status: pm_checks_status(task_id): read saved directions and failure counts (individual checks are in pm_task_memory); a tool dispatch, internal check, direction result and task goal are distinct. Reuse result/artifact/session references. Five failed units require returning to the coordinator; unknown outcome is never permission to retry.
pm_check_series: pm_check_series(task_id,plan_json): bounded HTTP GET Basic authentication or paths/traversal. Plan fields: kind(authentication|paths|traversal), url, hypothesis, max_requests(1..50, includes redirects), seconds(1..600), criterion{kind(authenticated|find_file|inventory),status:[codes],body_contains or sha256}, pairs:[{username,password,source_ref}] for authentication (1..5 concrete saved pairs), or paths:[origin-relative paths]; optional session_id and replan. Status alone cannot prove authentication or a particular file. Success stops remaining auth/file probes; inventory processes all planned paths. Five rejected pairs or unproductive path series return to coordinator. replan requires a newer running saved coordinator step with a reason and substantive new checks; wording/role/new IDs do not reset history. No replay of unknown outcomes. Uses existing HTTP captures/scope and reports internal units separately; not arbitrary shell/SSH instrumentation.
pm_publish_candidate: pm_publish_candidate(task_id,service_ref,username,secret,source_ref,quote,expected_version=-1): atomically publish a credential candidate backed by exact saved bytes for a known service. Another specialist may use it while you continue your assigned branch. This does not establish authentication/access or grant permission; no target operation or independent witness. Version conflicts require rereading memory, never repeating the original target action.
